metadata.description: Region of Azure AI Search (may differ from location when the region lacks Search capacity)
Project name used as prefix for resource names
PostgreSQL database name. Kept as workbenchiq: the application schema and existing data live in it.
Brand display name (OpenTelemetry service name). BRAND_NAME itself is baked into the images.
Container Registry SKU. Premium is required for dedicated build agent pools (demo uses Premium).
API key for backend authentication (min 32 chars)
Fabric API endpoint for Data Agent calls
Fabric workspace ID that contains the Data Agent item
Wire the Web IQ key (Key Vault secret webiq-api-key) into the API app. Enable after running infra/set-webiq-secret.ps1.
Create the Container Apps. First provisioning: false, build the images (deploy.ps1 -BuildOnly), then true.

Object IDs of the people or pipelines running deploy.ps1, set-webiq-secret.ps1 and the maintenance scripts. They get the data-plane roles those need on Foundry, Key Vault and Storage, which Owner/Contributor does not include.

Optional private networking: a VNet for the Container Apps environment, private endpoints for Storage, Key Vault, AI Search and Foundry, and PostgreSQL private access. Mirrors private_networking_enabled in infra/terraform.
Address space of the VNet (must be a /16 for the subnet layout). Used only when privateNetworkingEnabled is true.

Public IPs or CIDR ranges allowed through the Storage, Key Vault, AI Search and Foundry firewalls when privateNetworkingEnabled is true, so deploy.ps1 and set-webiq-secret.ps1 still work from an operator machine. Empty keeps those services private-only.
